OK so `vips__copy_4byte` with `swap=1` does `GUINT32_SWAP_LE_BE` which swaps between LE and BE. 

For writing the magic:
```c
vips__copy_4byte( !vips_amiMSBfirst(), to, (unsigned char *) &im->magic );
```
On LE machine, `!vips_amiMSBfirst()` = true, so it swaps. `im->magic = 0xb6a6f208` in memory (LE bytes: `08 f2 a6 b6`). After swap: `b6 a6 f2 08`. So the file has `b6 a6 f2 08`.

For reading the magic:
```c
vips__copy_4byte( !vips_amiMSBfirst(), (unsigned char *) &im->magic, from );
```
On LE machine, `!vips_amiMSBfirst()` = true, so it swaps. File bytes `b6 a6 f2 08` → after swap: `08 f2 a6 b6` = `0xb6a6f208` in memory. Correct!
